title: In openEQUELLA before 2026.1, the system.execute() function available to the scripting engine runs supplied operating…
description: In openEQUELLA versions before 2026.1, the system.execute() function in the scripting engine allows execution of arbitrary operating system commands without validation or an allow-list. This enables users with script creation or editing privileges to run commands with the openEQUELLA service account's privileges, leading to a critical security risk.
